rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person, object, or note that reminds you of something.

example.english: This photo is a reminder not to forget my original aspiration.
example.traditional: 張相係我嘅提醒，叫我唔好忘記初心。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 soeng2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 tai4 sing2 giu3 ngo5 m4 hou2 mong4 gei3 co1 sam1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a bill or written notice reminding someone to pay an outstanding amount.

example.english: I received a payment reminder today and only then realized I hadn't paid my credit card bill.
example.traditional: 我今日收到張催繳單，先知張卡數仲未交。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 sau1 dou2 zoeng1 ceoi1 giu2 daan1 sin1 zi1 zoeng1 kaat1 sou3 zung6 mei6 gaau1
